content: {"like":["Values high-quality visual and audio experience; prefers clean, sharp picture with no grain or artifacts.","Prioritizes immersive sound with clear dialogue and effective surround effects.","Enjoys engaging, well-written stories with strong characters and action-packed pacing.","Appreciates consistency and clarity in plot and character development.","Seeks overall pleasurable viewing that enhances enjoyment of favorite content."],"dislike":["Dislikes delays in availability of desired editions, especially extended versions not on Blu‑Ray until later years.","Finds premium pricing for partial seasons or splitting content unfair and wasteful.","Criticizes poor black levels that make episodes nearly unwatchable.","Rejects confusing or constantly changing plots and over‑the‑top acting.","Avoids content that feels tripe or a waste of time."]}
